description: Express TypeScript API boilerplate with intentionally vulnerable framework configuration, unchecked request types, and reflected response rendering.

vulnerabilities.description: User-controlled report_name flows into fs/promises.readFile as path (Snyk: javascript/PT, CWE-23)
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityImpact: Path traversal vulnerability allows an attacker to read arbitrary files on the system

vulnerabilities.description: Prototype pollution via recursive merge of user-controlled meta into profile object (Snyk: javascript/PrototypePollution, CWE-1321)
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityImpact: The banking web application uses a stringified JSON string to store metadata about memos, which due to a prototype pollution vulnerability in an insecure recurive JSON merge allows an attacker to pollute the prototype of the object, which subsequently allows an attacker to modify and persist database information

codeflowCrossService.description: Unescaped profile fields interpolated into HTML sent with text/html
